sanskrit: nāparīkṣita śiṣyāṇāṃ yogyatā siddhaśāsanekadāci * * raṃ vākyaṃ kadācitparuṣākṣeramkadācidbahuśomānyaḥ kadācidapi tāḍayetyo bhaktibhāvitamatiḥsayogyaḥ siddhaśāsanekṛtārtho'hamiti jñātvā sayogyaḥ siddhaśāsanena jahāti gurorbhaktiṃ sayogyaḥ siddhaśāsanevartatenanyabhāvena sa yogyaḥ siddhaśāsaneyadā samyakparīkṣāto * * yogyo tadā bhavettāvanna kārayeddīkṣāmityājñāṃ pārameśvarīniṣkalmaspadāntasya saṃsāravimukhasya catasya deyamidaṃ jñānamanyathā narakaṃ vrajetgurunindāparāṇāṃ ca devamaṃtra vidūṣiṇāmadeyametat svaśiṣyāṇāṃ suputrāṇāṃ ca nānyathāvināsamayadīkṣāṃ vai na dadyāt svapriyāya caājñābhangena deveśi dehapāto bhaviṣyatigacchati narakaṃ ghoramityājñāpārameśvarīpālanācca bhaveddevi mṛtyujit parameśvaraḥsaptavā paṃcavā trīṇi ekaṃ vā kṛta maṇḍalaḥmaṇḍalaṃ navaratnaiśca prakuryāt sārvakāmikamcatuḥsamena vā vṛttaṃ datvā vai hemapādukenipātya dharaṇīdeśe jānurdhve tu samāhitaḥtato vijñāyate bhaktyā guruṃ mokṣapradāyakamdehi me sadguro dīkṣāṃ dīnasyārtasya sarvathāyayākṛte bhavāmbodhistīryate caiva bandhanātsnātvā rājopacāreṇa sandhyāṃ nirvatyanukramāt

sanskrit: yathā krameṇārti harasya pūjane hyalankaret svaṃtanuśavyayaṃ smaranyāgālayaṃ bhavabhayārti harasya śambhoḥnānāpuṣpavicitrāḍhyaṃ praviśeddeśikottamaḥlatāmaṇḍapa saṃchannaṃ sevitaṃ yakṣakinnaraiḥnārangaistintintiṇībhiśca kadalī karmarankakaiḥtamālairbilvajambīraistathā vadaravṛkṣakaiḥvakulaiḥ kiṃkirātaiśca pāṭalairmadhūkaistathātagariḥ karavīraiśca mālatīkundayūthibhiḥkumudāmbuja kahlāraiḥ kvacinnīlotpalādibhiḥdevagandharvayakṣeśairvidyādhara mahoragaiḥsevitaṃ suprayatnena samantānmakhamaṇḍapamyakṣī vidyādharībhiśca sevitaṃ munidārakaiḥbhaktyā kṛtāñjalipuṭo yāga vāhye sthitāḥ stuvanyabhiḥ sugītaiḥ khalu śambhuyāga sevārase mattallvodbhaścagaṇeśvarairmatsyamṛgendrasūkaraiḥ śaśyanai kāmbikarūpadharakaiḥpritairbhṛśaṃścīgaṇamukhyahanyai? saṃrakṣitaṃ vāhyate? eva yatnataḥvighnonvitiḥ sārayato dvisaptakoṭisthitāstegaṇamukhyavṛndāḥnavaratnaugha * * varṣantī makhamaṇḍapamdaṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ dehalyāmastrarājakampūjayitvā prayatnena paścāllaṃghet svadehalīmniḥsarantantu vighnaughaṃ yāgamandiramadhyataḥāsadāśivaparyantaṃ tatvavrātātmakaṃ mahatkāñcanaṃ ratnakhacitaṃ dhyeyaṃ śaivantu maṇḍapamsāmānyārghajalenaiva prokṣyayanmaṇḍapottamampūrvānanotha vā saumye upaviśya susaṃyataḥ

sanskrit: tasminmaṇḍake sthāpyāḥ sarāvā paṃcaśobhanānivṛtyādika bījena āsanaṃ ca dadet tathāpaścimottara yāmyeṣu pūrve madhyeṣvanukramātvighnānmūbhyantarikṣasthān khecarānapi saṃsmaretnair-ṛtye vāstunāmānaḥ lakṣīṃ dvāre prapūjayetpaścimābhumukhe kuṇḍe śivaṃ sāngāmṛtīśvaramyajeddevaṃ ca devīṃ ca mahābhairavarūpiṇamvardhanyā taddaśāṃśena japtvā jāpyaṃ gurūstadāghaṭānugāminīṃ kṛtvā vardhanīṃ bhrāmayet tataḥvimuñcan payaso dhārān mūlamantarjayaṃ tadāsvasthāne tau vidhṛtvā tu praṇamyātha vadedidamrakṣathe maṃmakhaṃ yatnāt sāvadhānaṃ śivājñayāpūjayet sāngaṃ * malaṃ vardhanyāmastrabhairavamkumbhopari tu vinyasya śivakhaḍgaṃ śivājñayātayornamaskṛtiṃ kṛtvā paścāt saṃpūjayedgaṇamvāyavyāṃśitapadmasthaṃ gurūmīśānadigdalebhadrapīṭhe vare ramye snāpayejjagadīśvaramdhūpapuṣpāntaraṃ kṛtvā vidhinā maṃtrapūrvakamratnodakena śītena yatheṣṭaṃ snāpayet sudhīḥnavasūkṣmāṃvara vṛte puṣpādyaiḥ sthāpayecchivamdhyātvā vidhānato devaṃ lingalakṣau niveśayetsvaccha muktāphalaprakhyaṃ sphaṭikā * *? prabhamaśubhrahārendrakāntādi siddhabhūṣaṇa bhūṣitamsphuraccandrāmṛtasphāraṃ bahulormi pariplutamsitapadmopaviṣṭhaṃ ca vaddhapadmāsana sthitam

sanskrit: pūrṇacandranibhaṃ śubhramamṛtenaiva pūritamparipūrṇaṃ tathā candraṃ vāhahaste vicintayetbahunātra kimuktena sākṣādamṛtasāgaramatha cintāmaṇiprakhyaṃ bhāvabhedena saṃsmarethṛtpadme sarvasiddhyarthaṃ paścādbāhye prapūjayetanirmālyā parāśuddhā mokṣadā siddhidā śubhāādāveva prakartavyaṃ paścāddravyaiḥ savistaraiḥāgneyādi vibhāgena daleṣvangāni vinyasetnaivedyairvividhaiścitrairdhūpaiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ sudhūpitaiḥsarvaśvetopacāreṇa śāntyarthaṃ pūjayecchivamcaure durbhikṣake roge tathā maraṇasaṃkaṭenānāvighnaughaśāntyarthe sambhārairbahubhistathāsaprasādena dṛṣṭyā tu paśyantambhairavaṃ smaretcandrāmbunā tu saṃmarghaṃ lepayeddevamīśvaramkiṅkirāta navamālatikābhiḥ kundapāṭali suraktamambujaiḥpārijātārjunairnīla kahlārakaiḥ kuṭajapuṣpaistathā sindu vārārkajaiḥtrailokya duḥkhaharaṇīmabhayapradātrīmtato'guruṃ guggulayutaṃ sarpiṣā ca samanvitammanaḥ prasādajanakaṃ sarvavighnanivāraṇamdyūtena yācitāṃ dadyānnaivedyaṃ śambhave'grataḥdadhidugdhaṃ ghṛtenāpi yuktaṃ dadyānnivedyakametatsarvaṃ tu mūlena dadyācchambhoḥ samāhitaḥkṣālitaṃ śoṣitaṃ paścāddivākara marīcibhiḥsūkṣmaiścaitaiḥ samasṛṇairvastrairāchādayecchivampaścājjapaṃ kartavyamunmadhāngattamānasaḥ

sanskrit: śāmbhavena tu viddhasya cinhedaṃ saṃpravartatebhūtāntā śaktimaṃtrādau tathā hyevaṃ pracakṣatepratyaye sati mokṣo'sti anyathā tu kathaṃ bhavetviṣayojjhitamātreṇa dehenāena mucyatesa kathaṃ vāthanirmukto viṣayeṣu virajyateājñānande samutpannena gantavyaṃ guroḥ kṣaṇātjñātvā dīkṣāṃ purā dadyāt subhakte śiṣyake tadāp. 15b) maṇḍalaṃ kārayet tatra śubhaṃ padmasamanvitamśaktyāśaśinaḥ pūrṇaṃ maṇḍalāntantu vinyasettasminnāvāhayeddevaṃ sāngaṃ sagaṇamīśvarampūjayitvā tamamalaṃ mhābhairavarūpiṇamdhūpaiḥ sucandanaiḥ puṣpairdūrvākṣata sudīpakaiḥśivaṃ sāngaṃ tu saṃcintya mastake tu śiśostadāpunastasyaiva hastepi vidhinā pūjayecchivamkathayitvā vidhānena maṃtrātmānaṃ śiśorguruḥtataḥ paśyedguru hṛṣṭaḥ śiṣyaḥ prakṣiptapuṣpakamśiṣyasya nāmakaraṇaṃ śivāmarapraṇāntakammūlavinyastayā paścādañcayen mūrtimaṃtrataḥpaścātsāngāmṛtīśānaṃ mahāśrīsahitaṃ śivampaścātpūjārpayedagniṃ tato devāntikaṃ nayetmūlenāṣṭottaraśataṃ hunedvahnau tilānguruḥdurnimittāyanodāyāntarbhāvena saṃyutaḥsphulinginyavanisparśe jāniyāt pātakaṃ śiśoḥp. 16a) tejasvī cānalaḥ śasto jānīyācca śiśoḥ śubhamastreṇāṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuttilamuttamam

sanskrit: māṇikyamuktākhaṃcitairalaṃkāraiśca hyadbhūtaiḥhaimaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ chatraṃ datvā vai cāmare śubhekṣetragrāmādi viṣayairmaṇḍalaiśca śubhairvaraiḥgurau tatsarvathādeyaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ vinā śiśuḥtena tuṣṭe bhavet tuṣṭaḥ sākṣādamṛtamīśvaramtasmānna mānavīṃ buddhiṃ kārayed deśikaṃ pratisaṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ tārakaḥ parameśvaraḥśiṣyaḥ prahṛṣṭamanasā guroragre nivedayetdāsatvena śarīrādi gṛhāṇedaṃ hi madgurokarāvalambanaṃ datvā māmuddhṛtamacetanamtvameva śaraṇaṃ svāmin tṛṣārtānāṃ yathā jalamśarīraṃ prāṇamarthaṃ ca sadgurubhyo nivedayetbhaktiprahvasya śiṣyasya gurūṇābhūgatasya caananyabhāvato bhāvamāhnikaṃ naiva lopayetna jātu kutsitaṃ brūyādanicchantīṃ na kārayetdeśanindā na kartavyā śilpinena tiraskaretśivanindāparāṇāṃ ca saṃgatiṃ naiva kārayethāsyamuṣṇīśakaraṇaṃ yānavāhanasevanammaṇḍanaṃ darpaṇā lokamuttarvanama sauṣṭavammūrdhāpidhānaṃ vastreṇa sannikarṣopaveśanametānanyānapi tathā varjayet sarvathā śiśuḥdaṇḍapraṇāmake naiva svaguruṃ praṇamecchiśuḥvicāraṇātrano kāryā praṇameddarśane guroḥdṛṣṭvā guruṃ prayatnena vinītaḥ prāñjaliḥ śiśuḥguroḥ pāpakṣayaṃ yāti dhyānācchaiva mahacchiśoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00539 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yakṣāvidhādharāścaiva tathā kiṃ puruṣādayaḥgurvāyatte yataḥ sarva trailokyaṃ sa carācaramguruṃ sarvātmabhāvena paścāddināndhapūjanamkuryāttapasvi viprāṇāṃ naṭagāyanakeṣua cagurave parameśāya svātmānaṃ vinivedayetguruvastepi vijñeyāḥ susammānyā gururyathāsamānyāyogyatāmīkṣate jñānā'jñādibhiḥ kramāttanmūlāḥ siddhayaḥ sarvāḥ sarvatraiva vyavasthitāḥśāstralope kṛte luptaḥ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥtato viluptasaṃkāro narakādiṣu pacyatesamayasthaṃ samāyānti nivāsāyāṃ hi siddhayaḥsphoṭayecchailavṛkṣāṃśca samayācārapālanātpraṇamenna guruṃ śiṣyaḥ kāyena manasā nametvapane vamane caiva praṇamenna guruṃ śiśuḥguroragre tathaikānte vipṇvadhastādgurau sthitedvāramādau praṇamyātha praviśet saṃyataḥ śiśuḥtathaiva gurusaṃsparkācchiśoḥ pāpakṣayambhavetbahupralāpannavadedvadetyukte tu saṃvadetpādaprakṣālanaṃ svāpaṃ tathā pāda prasāraṇamanujñāṃ prāpya vā kuryādgurudṛṣṭeragocarammanasāpi na śiṣyeṇa kāmitavyā svamātṛvatguruṇā saha vāgvādaṃ kadācinnaiva kārayetḍolā ca vāhanaṃ caiva guruvat pūjayet sadātatsambhuktopakaraṇāṃ tadvatsaṃpūjayecchiśuḥtadbandhuvarge tu bhṛśaṃ guruvadvattayet sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00539 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadā svayaṃ ca praṇamedgurorbhaktiṃ vidarśayetsayāti narakaṃ ghoramityājñāpārameśvarīavīcī raurave caiva prajvalantāmra mandirepacyate bhuvanaṃ yāvadgurvājñālopane kṛteprāṇasaṃkaṭake prāpte svaprāṇāntetra muñcayetguruvat pūjanīyo syaikamapyāgatamādarātnarake śoyamavyagraṃ dhyātvā bhu * payet sukhamśivaśaktyoryataścihnairvyañjitaṃ saṃpradṛśyateataḥ saṃpūjayet sarvaṃ tatvavrātaṃ tadāśrayetbāhyalingapurābhyarcya paścādabhyantaraṃ yajettathā vai bhaktihīnasya śivapūjā nirarthakampaścāt paṃcakalādīkṣā navatatvātmikā punaḥtathaikatatvikā caiva dīkṣāmokṣā layā śubhāgadya bhaṃgyā tu kathitāṃ bhaktiyukte tu śiṣyakekathitāṃ padmabhangena jīvanmuktiṃ pradāyikāmbhuktimuktipradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ deśikā carcayantvidamkulākulasamudbhūtaṃ jñānadīkṣāsubodhitamviśveśvareṇa racitaṃ sajjanāṣvaryantvidamśarvaḥ sarvaṃ na jānāti tasmāt kṣamathadeśikāḥjñānapra * matināracitaṃ mayai tatśambhorvaktrasamudbhavā gamadhiyā tenaiva tannirmitam
